description: This file defines a Java class 'SampleActivityBase' that extends FragmentActivity and provides common logging setup and lifecycle management for Android sample activities.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class for Android sample projects that manages logging and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created, currently only calls super.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is starting, calls super and initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain using LogWrapper, enabling log messages to be properly routed.
